notes: Hand-entered Level 1-15 skill numbers, filled in by the user via exports/skill-leveling-template.xlsx (2026-07-21 onward) as a second pass over data/characters.json's Level-1-only capture. Not derived/generated — edit this file directly as more heroes are completed.

Each skill's `byLevel` array is positional and matches the order of that skill's `params` list in data/skillParams.json — e.g. byLevel['1'][0] is the same value as params[0] at Level 1. Re-derive skillParams.json (scripts/extractSkillParams.js) before trusting that alignment if characters.json's abilitiesRaw text changes.

Some skills' description text gains a new clause (and therefore a new parameter) at a level checkpoint, which can't be captured until a fresh in-game screenshot at/after that level is taken. For those skills, byLevel simply stops at the last confirmed level rather than guessing — see each skill's `incomplete` field.
Levels absent from a skill's byLevel map have not been captured yet; this is expected mid-pass, not a data error.

A few heroes started with placeholder 'X%' text in data/characters.json's abilitiesRaw instead of real Level 1 wording (byLevel numbers were recorded from the user's in-game captures directly, with param meaning unconfirmed until the placeholder text got replaced). Capevincible was the first case and has since been fully resolved (2026-07-21, hero dossier screenshots) — characters.json/skillParams.json were corrected and this note is kept as a pointer in case another hero turns up with the same placeholder-text situation.
